transformerParams.openApiDocument:
openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: Spotify Web API excerpt — get-playlist
  version: 0.0.1
  description: Faithful subset of https://developer.spotify.com/reference/web-api/open-api-schema.yaml
    for GET /playlists/{playlist_id} (operationId get-playlist) plus PUT change-playlist-details.
    Includes PlaylistObject, TrackObject, SimplifiedArtistObject, ImageObject, paging/owner
    allOf, ImageObject nullable height/width, and PlaylistTrackObject.track oneOf.
paths:
  /playlists/{playlist_id}:
    parameters:
    - $ref: '#/components/parameters/PathPlaylistId'
    get:
      operationId: get-playlist
      summary: Get Playlist
      parameters:
      - name: fields
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A playlist
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PlaylistObject'
    put:
      operationId: change-playlist-details
      summary: Change Playlist Details
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Playlist updated
components:
  parameters:
    PathPlaylistId:
      name: playlist_id
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
  schemas:
    ImageObject:
      type: object
      required:
      - url
      - height
      - width
      properties:
        url:
          type: string
        height:
          type: integer
          nullable: true
        width:
          type: integer
          nullable: true
    PlaylistUserObject:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        href:
          type: string
        type:
          type: string
        uri:
          type: string
    PlaylistOwnerObject:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PlaylistUserObject'
      - type: object
        properties:
          display_name:
            type: string
            nullable: true
    PagingObject:
      type: object
      required:
      - href
      - items
      - limit
      - next
      - offset
      - previous
      - total
      properties:
        href:
          type: string
        limit:
          type: integer
        next:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        offset:
          type: integer
        previous:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        total:
          type: integer
        items:
          type: array
          items: {}
    SimplifiedArtistObject:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        type:
          type: string
          enum:
          - artist
    TrackObject:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        artists:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/SimplifiedArtistObject'
        duration_ms:
          type: integer
        href:
          type: string
        type:
          type: string
          enum:
          - track
    EpisodeObject:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        type:
          type: string
          enum:
          - episode
    PlaylistTrackObject:
      type: object
      properties:
        track:
          oneOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/TrackObject'
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/EpisodeObject'
    PagingPlaylistTrackObject:
      allOf:
      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PagingObject'
      - type: object
        properties:
          items:
            type: array
            items:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PlaylistTrackObject'
    PlaylistObject:
      type: object
      properties:
        collaborative:
          type: boolean
        description:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        href:
          type: string
        id:
          type: string
        images:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ImageObject'
        name:
          type: string
        owner:
          allOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PlaylistOwnerObject'
        public:
          type: boolean
        snapshot_id:
          type: string
        tracks:
          type: object
          allOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PagingPlaylistTrackObject'
        type:
          type: string
        uri:
          type: string
